discoveries.title: Melas Basalt Bedrock Core
discoveries.desc: Tholeiitic basalt bedrock rich in pyroxene, plagioclase, and magnesium-rich olivine. Represents primordial Noachian planetary crust exposed by monumental tectonic rifting.

objectives.text: Leave capsule zone and enter Melas Chasma canyon floor.
Visit Workshop Station & complete Gear Traction Minigame.
Drill & collect Noachian basalt bedrock core.
Transmit canyon data to Earth relay.

targets.name: Melas Basalt Bedrock Core
targets.info: Tholeiitic basalt bedrock rich in pyroxene, plagioclase, and magnesium-rich olivine. Represents primordial Noachian planetary crust exposed by monumental tectonic rifting.
targets.astroPotential: MODERATE - Radiolytic Hydrogen Energy for Subsurface Microbes

objectives.text: Visit Dune Workshop & complete Wave Radar Minigame.
Use Ice Radar (SPACE) near ancient paleolake bed to scan subsurface ice.
Reach high delta rim comm tower.

targets.name: Neretva Subsurface Permafrost Ice
targets.info: Glacial cryo-lens buried 0.4m beneath fine aeolian quartz-silt. Formed during the late Hesperian lacustrine drying phase; contains preserved ancient water molecules.

objectives.text: Visit Glacier Workshop & complete Shield Circuit Minigame.
Scan geothermal magma vent for sub-ice heat.
Mark future human settlement dome site.

targets.name: Chasma Boreale Geothermal Magma Vent
targets.info: Sub-glacial volcanic fumarole venting sulfurous compounds and hydrothermal water vapor into glacial crevasses. A prime candidate for geothermal power and sub-ice habitats.

objectives.text: Visit Lava Forge Workshop & install Thermal Dampers.
Cross Basalt Bridge over lava lake to Central Core Island.
Extract Superheated Pyroxene crystal from core island.
Cross South Causeway to activate Geothermal Power Generator.

targets.name: Athabasca Superheated Pyroxene Crystal
targets.info: High-pressure clinopyroxene single crystal extracted from late Amazonian fissure lava. Formed in magma chambers at 1200°C; demonstrates deep Martian mantle convection dynamics.

targets.name: North Volcanic Fissure Vent
targets.info: Elemental sulfur-encrusted chimney venting gaseous HCl, SO₂, and superheated volcanic steam.

objectives.text: Visit Apex Engineering Nexus & calibrate Solar Quantum Shielding.
Gather rare Olivine Crystals from the caldera rim.
Align Deep Space Quantum Uplink dish to Earth.
Power up the Primary Colonization Habitat Dome!

targets.name: Summit Olivine Phenocryst
targets.info: Ultra-pure green forsteritic olivine formed under extreme pressure and preserved at 21.2 kilometers altitude, where atmospheric pressure is a near-vacuum 0.07 kPa.
targets.astroPotential: MODERATE - High-Altitude Cosmic Radiation Shielding Proxy
